s.note: the perfect little town with shoes hanging over the road
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes and mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread and cut into triangles. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon. Lay it out on a picnic blanket.
Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell for 2 hours in water with 80g salt and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning. Soak an hour off the heat, drain and serve warm in paper cones.

m.how: Score a 1.5kg whole snapper and rub with Cajun seasoning and 50g butter. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry hush puppies of 150g cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg. Shred a quarter cabbage for slaw. Serve with lemon.

w.note: the field of daffodils for Sandra
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs and lemon zest and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Soak with hot lemon syrup, then ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice and a touch of yellow.

d.note: Edward works three years for the circus
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 3 tbsp maraschino cherry syrup and a squeeze of lime to each and top with 200ml soda water. Drop in a cherry.
